title: Christine Gedye Landscapes
description: Luminous atmospheric paintings of the Pacific Northwest. This site shows Chris' exhibited paintings from 2010 to the present.

title: Antipodes
description: If you could dig a hole through the Earth where would you come out? We live on a very watery planet.

title: Family Photos
description: Family and travel photos from 2005 onwards.

title: 1956 Expedition
description: An openSeadragon view of John Hoyte's 1956 scrapbook. See [this substack essay](https://gedye.substack.com/p/hannibal-hoyte-and-happenstance) to get a better sense of John's extraordinary character and adventures.

title: Great Circles
description: What is the wettest or driest circumference of the Earth? This one is pretty geeky!

title: Montages
description: David's manipulated photographs: Reflections in space and translations in time.

title: Essays and Poems
description: David's substack. From longform non-fiction verse to explorations of a tricky mathematical sequence.

title: Just Keep Running
description: David's motivator to get out there most mornings. It tracks his progress against goals, shows all the fun shapes he likes to make, and even tracks his imagined run around the entire planet.

title: Amoeba Soup
description: These little fellows are calm, but hungry. David is not exactly sure why he finds them so soothing.

title: Boxcraft
description: Efficient and attractive rectangle packing algorithms. Used for showing my running routes from Strava, but hopefully applicable more broadly.
